method.open: SQLite URI mode=ro; PRAGMA query_only=ON; one BEGIN/COMMIT read transaction
method.authorizer: Only SELECT/transaction and exact original identity columns plus settings.key/value allowed. Sole settings query is WHERE key = unsentWork.v1. Writes, other columns/tables denied.

identityQueries.sessions: SELECT id, agent_id, cwd, native_session_id, created_at FROM sessions ORDER BY id
identityQueries.agents: SELECT id, source, command, created_at FROM agents ORDER BY id
identityQueries.dismissed_sessions: SELECT id, created_at FROM dismissed_sessions ORDER BY id

method.canonicalJson: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')); SHA-256 lowercase hex
method.identityHash: Hash object composed only of identityFields; ID is stored separately and is not repeated inside the per-record hash
method.exportedIdentityRedaction: Only SHA-256 of original IDs and identity objects. No original/new raw IDs, field values, titles, draft text or choice values emitted.

originalGlobalDraft.metadataInterpretation: Only original user-content fields and complete choice determine original-draft preservation. Other draft stores are counted, never required empty, and their contents are not exported.

sourceFreeze.boundary: Only the 243 frozen source paths were checked. No build/test rerun or source edit.

prototypeFreeze.boundary: 161 selected src/tests/index/vite files and their selected path set only. Outside-manifest files are not automatically new or changed; no claim about their prior byte identity.

checkedScope: Spotlight bundle identifier ai.farfold.desktop results, each rechecked for existence and Info.plist identity
soleFormalApplication.boundary: Read-only bounded application inventory plus indexed matches; not an exhaustive scan of all unindexed storage.

operatorContext.ownTestDraftCleanup: Parent reports only own C5 image draft/attachment, own queue edit/input and current feedback test content were cleaned through UI. This audit does not infer the contents of other draft stores or repeat cleanup.
operatorContext.uiReceiptLayer: Original global draft and choice visibly restored/unsent, plus favorites/group restoration, are parent UI observations; this file independently verifies stored original fields and identity only.

excluded: Agent-owned history files and conversation bodies
Content inspection or export of other composers/feedback/queues
limits: Original index identity equality does not prove every native history body or credential is intact; those were not read or modified.
All current database rows are retained. Added own test records are counted separately; no database write or deletion was performed.
Draft preservation compares original new-composer fields and complete choice; unrelated drafts/queues/feedback are only counted and need not be empty.
Current disk application hashes, process path/start and frozen source identity are checked; this is not a replay of every installed journey.
No UI operation, Agent start/request, production edit, old evidence edit, or engineering test was performed.

deliveryBoundary.failureEvidenceVerification: IME failure and screenshot numbering are parent observations; this data audit did not operate UI or independently replay it. Exact screenshot paths are not asserted here.
deliveryBoundary.futureCandidateSourceChanges: Source identity is only the candidate7 snapshot at completedAtUtc. Later authorized candidate8 Composer changes are not evaluated by this snapshot and are not user-data corruption.
